stem:
Hector surveyed all the sixth graders at his school about their favorite after-school activity. The table shows the results that were used to make a bar graph.

Favorite Activities

| Activity     | Number of Students |
|--------------|--------------------|
| Reading      | 44                 |
| Sports       | 55                 |
| Video games  | 55                 |
| Music        | 66                 |

Which percentage bar graph best represents the data?
visual_elements: Four percentage bar graph options labeled A, B, C, D
notes: Answer choices show segmented bar graphs with different segment lengths representing different percentages; exact segment lengths not transcribed because they're graphical.
